# Aaqif Shafi — Full-Stack Product Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Aaqif Shafi, a full-stack product engineer based in Kashmir, India. Building end-to-end products across web, realtime, and iOS: Next.js, Node.js, Swift, and everything in between.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org) to give language models a concise, structured summary of the site.

## Experience

- Designfolio — Full-Stack Product Engineer (May 2026 – Present) — https://designfolio.me
  Portfolio builder for designers and developers. Built the full jobs board (scraping, Kanban, AI match scoring), mock interview, resume tailor, cover letter generation, Tiptap case study editor, and dynamic templates. Next.js, Express.js, JavaScript, MongoDB, Vertex AI, Razorpay, Vercel, AWS.

- People of Bengaluru — Full-Stack Product Engineer (Oct 2026 – Present) — https://peopleofbengaluru.com
  A stylized 3D Bengaluru you walk through to discover the city's designers and builders. Built the game world in React Three Fiber, live multiplayer on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects, in-city chat and connections, invites, applications with Dodo Payments, sign-in, and the admin. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Resend.

- Tapaway — iOS & Full-Stack Engineer (Aug 2026 – Present) — https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tapaway-digital-detox/id6801114477
  iOS digital-detox app that locks chosen apps behind a physical NFC tag — tap to lock, tap again to unlock. Built the SwiftUI app, Screen Time (FamilyControls, ManagedSettings, DeviceActivity) and Core NFC integration, schedules and auto re-lock, Supabase sync, the Next.js web store with Dodo Payments, and the App Store release. Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, Supabase.

- Gistr Technologies — Fullstack Product Engineer (Jan 2025 – Apr 2026) — https://gistr.so
  AI knowledge workspace. File ingestion pipelines (PDF, EPUB, DOCX, PPTX, podcasts, web), credit-based billing with Dodo Payments, BullMQ job queues, PostHog analytics, core AI features. NestJS, Next.js, BullMQ, MongoDB.

Each project has a detailed case study at https://aaqif.is-a.dev/work/<slug> (designfolio, people-of-bengaluru, tapaway, gistr).
